system.description:
All darkness shares kinship with its ultimate source, and you can step through one shadow to emerge from another, your form briefly flickering like moonlight through branches.

You must be standing in a naturally occurring shadow — never one made by Obtenebration. Spend two Blood Traits and win a Static Mental Challenge against a seven-Trait difficulty to shift up to 50 steps to another natural shadow within your line of sight, carrying your clothes and possessions up to half your body weight. You are not considered to pass through the intervening space. Used as Fair Escape it happens at normal action speed, so someone using Alacrity may still stop you. For one additional Willpower Trait you may bring one other person; an unwilling companion must be beaten in a Physical Challenge or neither of you moves. Escaping restraint likewise costs a Willpower Trait and a won Physical Challenge against the bonds or captor (a Narrator sets the Physical Traits of any bindings).
system.bloodCost: 2 Blood Traits (+1 Willpower for a companion)
